g.title: add_succ
g.text: (a d : ℕ) : a + succ d = succ (a + d)

g.title: succ_add
g.text: (a b : ℕ) : succ a + b = succ (a + b)

g.title: add_comm
g.text: (a b : ℕ) : a + b = b + a

g.title: add_assoc
g.text: (a b c : ℕ) : a + b + c = a + (b + c)

g.title: le_total
g.text: (x y : ℕ) : x ≤ y ∨ y ≤ x
